<!-- pr-reviewer: 8ea652d89b70de8cbea42024f5da2421237c6b51 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The design is clean and off-by-default is byte-identical, but the Prime Directive bound on the smoothing deviation has gaps (items 1-3).

**What looks good**
- Off writes nothing: no PARAM, and `postOptions` omits the key (`posting.rs` options_value). Project key is additive and skipped when false (`project/file.rs`).
- Reset is in `endPreamble` in every mill dialect, so it is written at every section end and before the next section; drill/tap/probe/thread/lathe kinds ask nothing (`smoothing.rs` `of`). Finish ops ask exactly their own tolerance; the rough value is clamped and non-finite input falls to the floor.
- Mazak names the ask once and writes no guessed word. Layering, provenance lines, decision record, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #616` are all in place. No build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.

**Local results (merged with fresh upstream/main, no conflicts; AGENTS.md only came from main)**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| smoothing | 4 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| tormach_post / fanuc_post | 10 / 11 passed |
| heidenhain_block_form / sinumerik_safe_retract | 4 / 3 passed |
| coolant / after_op / per_op_files | 7 / 10 / 9 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| lathe_post_g76 | 5 passed |
| camcraft-ui --lib (from crates/ui) | 376 passed, 1 failed: the known GPU-adapter test, `headless_run_succeeds` ("No suitable graphics adapter found"), an environment issue |
| clippy post+app+ui, all targets, -D warnings | clean |

(The PR's "ui structural / post_options / after_op" are not separate test binaries here; I ran the ui lib instead.)

**Requested before merge**
1. Fanuc never states the tolerance: `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` `smoothOn` writes only `G5.1 Q1`, so the deviation is whatever the control's AI contour parameters allow, not the op's tolerance. A finish op's "never looser than its tolerance" guarantee therefore does not hold on Fanuc. Either write a bounded form (tolerance/level word from the Fanuc manual) or refuse by name for finish ops (and say so in the UI hover text), rather than silently enabling an unbounded smoothing.
2. The rough floor can exceed the stock: `smoothing.rs` `rough_tol` clamps to a 0.01 mm minimum, so stock-to-leave 0.01-0.04 mm gives a deviation of 25-100% of the allowance (stock 0.01 -> 0.01 = the whole allowance), contradicting the "a fifth of the allowance" law and the decision record. Never exceed the stock itself (e.g. `min(stock * 0.2 ...)` or skip smoothing under a small stock) and add a test for it.
3. Verified path: the toolpath is generated and simulated at the op's tolerance, then the control may deviate by up to the same tolerance again, so the finished part can differ from what was verified by up to ~2x tolerance. Please bound it (e.g. ask half the tolerance, or document and surface that the verified path is not the smoothed path) and say which in the decision record.
4. Missing tests the contract needs: undo/redo of `SetPostOptions { smoothing }` and a save/load round-trip of the `smoothing` key (nothing in `project_roundtrip` or the ui tests touches it), and a section-end reset assertion at program end after the last op.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `schema.rs` doc comment and `post/mod.rs` still mention `CYCL DEF 32`; the post writes ISO `G62`. Please align the comments.
- Tormach's off word hard-codes the header's `P0.001`/`P0.025`; it would be safer to share one constant with the header.
- None of the words was run on a control or simulator, as the PR says; opt-in is the right call.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e609a6ee9cb3dc487d7d43f5601216139930e21e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review at e609a6ee; all four earlier blockers are fixed).

**Verified fixes**
1. Fanuc: `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` smoothOn now names the ask once ("SMOOTHING NOT WRITTEN - G5.1 STATES NO TOLERANCE") and writes no G5.1; smoothOff writes nothing. Pinned by `fanuc_and_mazak_name_the_ask_once_and_write_no_unbounded_word`.
2. `rough_tol` (`crates/app/src/smoothing.rs`) is now stock x 0.2, capped at 0.25, no floor, `None` for non-finite or non-positive. The test checks <= a fifth for 0.001, 0.02, 0.04, 0.5 and 1.25 mm.
3. Finish asks tol x `FINISH_SHARE` (0.5). The 1.5x stack-up is documented in the module header and in `docs/decisions/616-smoothing.md`.
4. New tests `the_switch_undoes_redoes_and_round_trips_the_project_file` (undo, redo, key written when on, absent when off, reload) and `the_smoothing_reset_comes_before_the_program_end` (Tormach, Haas, Siemens, Heidenhain).
- The Heidenhain comment is corrected, and Tormach uses a shared `blendP()` for the header and the reset.

**Local results** (trial merge with fresh `upstream/main`: clean, no conflicts; no build.rs, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes; no CHANGELOG.md edit)
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| smoothing | 6 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| lathe_post_g76 | 5 passed |
| fanuc_post | 11 passed |
| tormach_post | 10 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| camcraft-post post_engine | 33 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings` (app, post, ui, all targets) | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- On the 1.5x stack-up: the path is generated and verified at tol, and the control may add tol/2, so the worst case is 1.5x tol. It is stated openly and applies only when the smoothing switch is on (default off). It is also tighter than the earlier 2x. I do not think it blocks. I would still surface it to the maintainer as a policy choice: if "tolerance" is meant as a hard bound on the final part, a finish ask of tol/3 would make the stack exactly tol, or the generator could be run at tol/2.
- Fanuc and Mazak now write nothing, so a user who turns smoothing on gets only a note on those posts. That is safe, and #614 tracks the bounded form.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Delta review (merge of main only): since the last reviewed head e609a6e, the only new commit is the merge of main (5f63d82). I read the combined diff of all seven conflicted hunks.

- Resolution is right, both sides kept: `PostOptions` in `schema.rs` has `smoothing` then `end_units` (#596) with `EndUnits` intact; `options_value` in `posting.rs` states "Smoothing" only when on and still writes "EndUnits"; `project/apply.rs` reads `smoothing: file.smoothing` plus #596's `end_units` match; `wire.rs` writes both (end_units inside `post_options`, smoothing top-level); `pages.rs` calls `smoothing_switch` then `end_units_picker`; `post_options.rs` keeps both widgets and a merged module doc; `tormach.cps` keeps #594's `note(clean(nm))`, the probe-no-coolant preamble and `smoothOn()`/`blendP()`.
- Nothing from main was dropped: `git diff upstream/main HEAD --stat` lists only the PR's 18 files (smoothing module and tests, six posts, post mod, UI, schema, project, decisions).

Local results (PR head, merges with main cleanly):
- app `smoothing` 6/6, `tormach_end_units` 7/7, `tormach_post` 10/10, `project_roundtrip` 71/71, `posting` 17/17, `per_op_files` 9/9, `lathe_post_g76` 8/8, `after_op` 10/10, `probe_tormach` 7/7 pass.
- ui lib (from `crates/ui`, filter post_option/end_units/smoothing/after_op) 3/3 pass.
- clippy `-D warnings`: app and post libs plus smoothing, tormach_end_units, tormach_post, project_roundtrip tests, and the ui lib: clean.

Note (not a blocker): #515 also adds `end_units`, to a per-setup DTO; whichever of #515 / this PR lands second will need to reconcile how the document-level `post_options.end_units` and the per-setup field interact.

Nothing requested. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Delta review** of the merge-of-main since my last review at `e609a6e`. Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What changed since `e609a6e`:** only the author's merge commit `5f63d82` ("Merge main into issue/616-smoothing") on top of main's own merges. No new own code.

**Checked**
- Resolution keeps both sides in every conflicted file: `tormach.cps` (main's #594 `note(clean(nm))` header and probe `touchProbe` spindle/coolant gate both survive, with this PR's `blendP()` and `smoothOn()` added); `posting.rs::options_value` (the `Smoothing` word plus main's `EndUnits` word); `project/apply.rs` (`smoothing` plus #596's `end_units` parse, unknown value refused as corrupt); `schema.rs` (`smoothing` field and `EndUnits` enum); `lib.rs` (both modules); ui `pages.rs` and `post_options.rs` (smoothing switch and end-units picker both drawn).
- Main's newer rules are intact: per-machine tool clash, per-mount NC files, probe hooks, Tormach safe_retract, comment escaping, end-in-native-units. `gh pr diff --name-only` lists only the PR's own files (the six mill `.cps` posts it extends, posting, project, schema, smoothing, post crate mod, ui options, decision file). No snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG or RECOMMENDED edits.
- Trial merge with current main (one newer commit, touching only `lathe_thread_travel.rs`): clean.

**Results (head merged with main, own worktree and target)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test smoothing --test posting --test golden_cl --test tormach_post --test fanuc_post --test tormach_end_units`: all pass (golden_cl 23, smoothing 6).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `-p camcraft-ui --lib`: clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
